description: Every Redmine feature, plus a local mirror that finally answers the cross-project questions the Roadmap page never could.

novel_features.name: Roadmap Burndown
novel_features.description: See open/closed issue counts, average completion, and logged-vs-estimated hours for a release version — the Roadmap page Redmine never exposed as an API.

novel_features.name: Assignee Workload Report
novel_features.description: See every assignee's open-issue count and estimated hours in one aggregate view, with a flag for anyone over threshold.

novel_features.name: Stale Issue Detection
novel_features.description: Find open issues nobody has touched in N days — Redmine has no built-in staleness concept.

novel_features.name: Since-Last-Sync Digest
novel_features.description: A personal activity report of what was created, updated, or closed in a time window, optionally scoped to issues assigned to or watched by you.

novel_features.name: Cycle-Time by Tracker
novel_features.description: Average days from creation to close, grouped by tracker or project — real duration math the API can't do.

novel_features.name: Transitive Blocker Chain
novel_features.description: Walk the full multi-hop 'blocks'/'blocked by' dependency chain for an issue, not just its direct relations.
